notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Drake creatures.
description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes ability, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Gemstone Array's abilities any number of times.
